scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules app/.expo app/node_modules app/package-lock.json server/node_modules server/package-lock.json UtilitiesForPC/node_modules UtilitiesForPC/package-lock.json UtilitiesForPC/dist UtilitiesForPC/dist-electron UtilitiesForPC/build types/node_modules && cd app && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run install-all
scripts.format-all: cd app && npm run format-all && cd ../server && npm run format-all
scripts.install-all: cd app && npm i && cd ../UtilitiesForPC && npm i && cd ../server && npm i && cd ../types && npm i
